summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 (Alpine Linux) as a shared writable directory with the sticky bit set (mode 1777, owned by root:root), so any user can create files but only the file owner (or root) can remove/rename them. Verified functionally before and after a full node restart, and confirmed the restart via a changed OS boot_id.
actions_performed: Created /srv/drop and set mode 1777, owner root:root

Created two temporary test users (dropuserA, dropuserB) and verified: both can create files in /srv/drop; user B cannot delete user A's file (Operation not permitted due to sticky bit); user A can delete its own file
Cleaned up test files and test user accounts, leaving /srv/drop in its final configured state
Captured pre-restart boot_id and /srv/drop permissions baseline
Issued a self-terminating background reboot command on node1 so the acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec access returned
Confirmed boot_id changed (d22a0434-520e-4577-a2ff-4f2f89a334d5 -> fef8c35e-b6dc-4a2c-bf9a-e6de7c5ef717), proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified /srv/drop mode/ownership and re-ran the full cross-user create/delete-blocked/self-delete-allowed functional test post-restart
Cleaned up the second round of test users/files

evidence.requirement: /srv/drop created with correct sticky, world-writable permissions
evidence.summary: mkdir + chmod 1777 + chown root:root, verified via stat showing drwxrwxrwt root:root

evidence.requirement: Functional proof: shared writable, cannot remove others' files (pre-restart)
evidence.summary: Two real users each created a file; cross-user rm failed with 'Operation not permitted'; owner successfully deleted their own file

evidence.requirement: Cleanup of test artifacts before final state check
evidence.summary: Test files and accounts removed; final /srv/drop left with mode 1777 root:root and no leftover test users

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline and boot identity
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (d22a0434-520e-4577-a2ff-4f2f89a334d5) and confirmed /srv/drop permissions healthy
Backgrounded self-reboot command returned 'reboot scheduled' before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node restart in progress / node unreachable
evidence.summary: Repeated polling attempts failed with connection reset/timeout while node1 was rebooting

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just elapsed time)
evidence.summary: Exec access returned with new boot_id fef8c35e-b6dc-4a2c-bf9a-e6de7c5ef717, differing from pre-restart boot_id

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required config and functional behavior
evidence.summary: Post-restart stat confirms /srv/drop still mode 1777 root:root; repeated full functional test (create by two users, cross-delete blocked, self-delete allowed) passed identically after restart
